email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Brand Media Intern position at Levi Strauss & Co. in Brussels. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web projects, I am excited about the opportunity to support the German Brand Media Manager in executing and implementing brand media campaigns.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has honed my organizational skills and ability to juggle multiple projects. I am comfortable with Excel and PowerPoint, and I have a solid understanding of the media ecosystem, including digital and social channels. My work on mirook.com involved implementing structured data and optimizing for AI search, demonstrating my appetite for learning and adapting to new trends.

I am fluent in English, have a B1 level in Dutch, and am eager to deepen my understanding of the German market. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and can easily commute to Brussels.

I would love to bring my enthusiasm and skills to the world's number one denim brand. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

- Media & Campaign Support: coordinating assets, managing calendars, tracking billing, supporting media plans
- Digital Marketing & SEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & Build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration

- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
